CustomField.description: The physical meter number stamped on the device. FSD 5.10.4 names this as the number handed to an incoming tenant at move in, which is one of the two use cases the whole register exists to serve.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The number printed on the meter itself. This is the number you give an incoming tenant at move in, so copy it exactly, including any leading zeros.
CustomField.label: Meter Number
